name: Deep Within the Temple of the Wolf
description: The Knights of Favonius have been mobilized to contain Stormterror's destruction. Venture forth with Cavalry Captain Kaeya to the Temple of the Wolf and stop Stormterror from gaining the power within.

name: Hidden Teardrop in the Heart of the Jungle
description: The party has come to a secret ruin hidden deep in a jungle. One of Dvalin's powerful teardrops lies within. Head inside with Jean and Diluc to track it down.

name: Retrieve the Treasure
description: The Abyss Mage has fled into the Domain. Brave the Domain and retrieve Klee's treasure!

name: The Golden Shadow
description: Your pursuit of the truth brings you to the very heart of the political storm that has been slowly brewing in Liyue Harbor. It is time to peer beyond the glittering gold, and see what lurks in the shadows...

name: Memories: The Golden Shadow I
description: The storm clouds gathering over Liyue have finally parted, and the schemes that once gripped this land have been shattered by the combined efforts of the Qixing, the adepti, and yourself. Still, the memories of your duel with Childe of the Fatui in the depths of the Golden House remain fresh in your mind. Relive this duel, and you may yet learn something new...

As the moon traces its path across the night sky, its quiet light meets the resolve of those who stand here to protect their home. Together, they remind us of what "home" truly means. Reflecting on this battle for the fate of the sublunary sphere may reveal something you haven't noticed before...

name: Memories: A Deluded Thought I
description: The moment the heretic took hold of the axis that anchors the world's memories, he began to style himself as an enlightened being who had transcended ignorance and illusion, and whose actions were no longer bound by the strictures of Reason. Yet, such certainty was nothing more than a grand delusion. That so-called true wisdom — that unwillingness, or perhaps inability, to offer salvation and liberation to all — proved in the end to be merely another shackle of extinction. His ruin was thus assured, much like the sovereign who forged the Reason of Essence-less Emptiness who remains forever shackled in a prison of their own making.

name: Deep Within the Temple of the Falcon
description: The Knights of Favonius have been mobilized to contain Stormterror's destructive rampage. Venture forth with Amber the Outrider to the Temple of the Falcon and stop Stormterror from gaining the power within.

name: Find the Stolen Book
description: The thief seems to be hiding inside this ruin...

name: Deep Within the Temple of the Lion
description: The Knights of Favonius have been mobilized to contain Stormterror's destruction. Venture forth with Lisa the Librarian to the Temple of the Lion and stop Stormterror from gaining the power within.

name: Hunt Down the Abyss Mage
description: The Abyss Mage has disappeared somewhere deep inside this underground ruin. Do not spare this evildoer.

name: Retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: The treasure of Mondstadt and the power of the Anemo Archon will not simply be handed over quietly. Defeat the guards inside and take back the Holy Lyre der Himmel.

name: Secret Ingredient
description: Xiangling is sure that the ingredient she's looking for is hidden somewhere in the depths of this domain. So fight your way to the far end and retrieve it — if you've got the guts!

name: The Great Adventurer Stanley
description: Ellin asked you to search for the greenhorn adventurer Jack within the Temple of the Lion. It seems he is traveling together with the legendary adventurer, Stanley.

name: Another Detour
description: Despite consulting her notebook, Qiqi dashes into the ruins for reasons unknown. You've heard that it's dangerous in there. Catch up to her and ensure her safety.

name: Karma-Heavy Cavern
description: This place attracts monsters corrupted by sinister energy. According to Xiao, their mutation might be connected to his karmic debt...

name: Cloud Retainer's Abode
description: Herein lies the abode of Cloud Retainer. The adeptus desires not to see guests, and the way is shut. A lack of care for where one lays their head is common among all who live. Do you truly wish to enter?

name: The Wonderful World Of Mr. Cyclops
description: Though it was agreed to let Teucer visit the "Institute for Toy Research"... The toughest battles are not fought against a redoubtable foe but in defense of a child's innocence.

name: Of Mysteries and Salt
description: The seal has been broken, and both the treasures and the tale of the God of Salt await within. The party pushes on, each armed with disparate aims...

name: Cloud Retainer's Abode
description: Herein lies the abode of Cloud Retainer. The adeptus desires not to see guests, and the way is shut. A lack of care for where one lays their head is common among all who live. Do you truly wish to enter?

name: Enter the "border"
description: After sufficient preparation, you follow Hu Tao into the mysterious "border." Remember her warning and don't make a fuss about anything that waits ahead.

name: Deserted Ruins of Thermadon
description: Recently discovered underground ruins. Even though the Guild keeps warning of the dangers hidden inside, nothing can go wrong with Bennett by your side, right?

name: Deserted Ruins of Eya
description: Recently discovered underground ruins. Even though the Guild has repeatedly expressed safety concerns about venturing inside, nothing can go wrong with Bennett by your side, right?

name: Abyssal Traces
description: The abyssal traces have led you back here. Will the Abyss Herald rear its head and let you witness its transformation brought upon by the Abyssal Gospel?

name: Call of the Abyss
description: The ominous temptations of the Abyss lure the brave and the foolish alike. No matter the fate that has brought you hither, know that a new thread of fate is already being woven.

name: Call of the Abyss
description: The ominous temptations of the Abyss lure the brave and the foolish alike. No matter the fate that has brought you hither, know that a new thread of fate is already being woven.

name: Behind Enemy Lines
description: After winning Schubert's trust, he has decided to take to you to see his "friends from a distant land." The Fatui may be skulking within, so make sure to be fully prepared before stepping forward to investigate.

name: Police Detention Center
description: A location being used by the Police Station for temporarily detaining criminals. As well as being heavily guarded, there are also all manner of mechanisms to prevent criminals from escaping.

name: Delusion Factory
description: Delusions cannot be allowed to spread throughout Inazuma. You will not stand by idly and watch as they cause ever more suffering.

name: Hidden Mountain Base
description: Following the intelligence you got from Ippei, you discover the Takatsukasa Clan's hidden base. The Tenryou Commission is in a precarious state, and Kujou Kamaji has not returned. You do not yet know what has happened in this place...

name: Tenryou Commission Headquarters
description: Tenryou Commission Headquarters

name: Crumbling Guilt
description: After a round of pursuit, you and Itto have reached the ronin hideout. Only by breaking through the obstacles that lie ahead can you resolve the misunderstanding between the Crimson Oni and the Blue Oni.

name: Beneath the Vortex
description: Severely wounded, Beisht, The Avenger of the Vortex, has fled to this place. Watch yourself — this place is full of dangers.

name: Sea Gazer's Abode
description: An abode created by Sea Gazer. It has been abandoned for some time, but the adeptal energies within still power many an automatic defense system to deter trespassers.

name: Secret Summoning Chamber
description: The summoning site chosen by Yae Miko. Word on the street is that this is the summoning site with the highest rate of success.

name: Chamber of Twisted Cranes
description: A Domain you discovered for the first time while trapped within The Chasm. It seems to have been sealed for a very long time indeed.

name: City of Hidden Runes
description: A Domain you found by accident while searching for the way out. Many mystical mechanisms lie within.

name: Realm of Snaring Illusions
description: A wondrous space hidden within The Chasm's depths. It is a key location filled with many mysteries.

name: Qingxu Pool Underground Ruins
description: These ruins have been here for a very long time indeed, and digging here has temporarily ceased due to hard rocks blocking the path. It is said that rare treasures may be found below.

name: Occupied Hold
description: This was once a secret holding of the Takatsukasa Clan which was taken over by ronin after being abandoned. If you should meet any resistance on the way in... Well, might as well check how much strength remains in this mystical sword.

name: Blazin' Trails
description: This domain looms large as you visit another island shrouded in illusion. The strange plants around this domain resemble instruments. Perhaps this might prove the ideal stage for a certain resident rocker to show her stuff?

name: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part II
description: You discover a mysterious space while exploring the now-slightly-different Golden Apple Archipelago. This place seems intimately related to the quaint old bonsai that the Kaedehara Clan kept...

name: The Ancient Azure Stars
description: You find this strange realm under Mona's guidance. The way of entering this place is quite unique indeed. You reckon it must have quite the deep association with the genius astrologer...

name: The Ancient Azure Stars
description: You find this strange realm under Mona's guidance. The way of entering this place is quite unique indeed. You reckon it must have quite the deep association with the genius astrologer...

name: Immernachtreich Apokalypse: Part I
description: A mysterious realm that only Fischl's text, the "Hymn of the Holy Land," is able to unlock the path to. An austere and sacred aura surrounds this place, and the borders of common sense begin to blur here.

description: The source of contamination that lies deep within the forest. Abnormal Ley Line energy seems to flow out of it.

name: Mysterious Ruins
description: Mysterious ruins that have been hidden deep under layers of sand. An incomprehensible power seems to flow within...

name: Court of Desolation
description: Some strange association built this secret base at some point during the time of King Deshret. It is said that the secret to reviving the deceased is hidden here. Standing at the gate, you can hear heart-pounding drumming noises ringing in the depths.

name: Desert Vivarium
description: Many cities rose and fell like mirages in the night, as transient as falling meteors, in the days following the fall of the desert kingdom. Yet the garden of the city of sapphire has endured thanks to the protection of the white tree and the Ley Lines, and has now become a paradise for Fungi...

name: Behind the Illusory Curtain
description: The towers built upon the sands may have long collapsed, but the tribes who have yet to forget the desert king's dream are still lost amidst the ruins, holding hatred toward those who prosper in the forests, and who slather scorpion venom on their blades.

name: Edge of the End
description: The wise once debated wisdom in this corner of the ancient city, outlining the desert king's dream. After the bubble burst, this place became a secret holding cell for prisoners. Today, it has become a hotbed of monsters, but there are also treasures of the past to be found here.

name: The Greater Lord's Remaining Consciousness
description: Story Review:  You and Nahida successfully prevented the Akademiya's god-creation plan. With the Electro Gnosis in hand, you see where your hope of saving Irminsul lies...

name: Deus Foundry
description: "Creating a god... Yes, we are using human wisdom to create a god!" — Azar

name: That Day Under Irminsul
description: Story Review:  You and Nahida successfully prevented the Akademiya's god-creation plan and uncovered Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's final memory. Now the hope of saving Irminsul lies before your very eyes.

name: The Shrine of Shouki no Kami
description: Story Review:  You and Nahida rush over to prevent the Akademiya's god-creation plan. After getting through the passageway, you see The Balladeer, who is about to become a god...

name: Reminiscent Drift
description: The memories of a certain puppet. He can be The Balladeer, Harbinger of the Fatui, and he can also be the Kabukimono who was once sighted in Tatarasuna.

name: Secret Cavern
description: Ilyas guided you here. It seems to be the place where Siraj does his experiments...

name: Unknown Sanctuary
description: Hilichurls were seen heading towards this place, their steps faithful and unwavering. However, Eide tells you that he's never seen anything like this before...

name: Unknown Sanctuary
description: Hilichurls were seen heading towards this place, their steps faithful and unwavering. However, Eide tells you that he's never seen anything like this before...

name: Bygone Glories Passed
description: Led by Kusayla's old comrades, you arrive at the final hideout of Deshret's Relics. Fierce resistance is to be expected within, but it is time to call it curtains for vengeance, whether old or new.

name: Entanglement of Past Dreams
description: The restless force within Jialiang has beckoned him ceaselessly, drawing everyone to this place. Here, the stench of evil is growing, and the curtains of fate are soon to fall.

name: Aquanigma
description: According to the intelligence you have uncovered, this is where the culprit produces the Sinthe. There might be clues to the serial disappearances case inside. Quickly and carefully explore the place and look for conclusive evidence.

name: Magic Workshop
description: The Magic Workshop once used by Cesar. Judging by the pile of boxes at the entrance, nobody has come here in a very long time...

name: Youwang Cauldron
description: This was once a treasure granted to Qiaoying Village by an adeptus from Jueyun. As the tea-making process has changed, the Youwang Cauldron has long ceased to serve the same key function it used to. However, its symbolic role in the hearts of the villagers is likely irreplaceable...

name: Dougier's "Kingdom"
description: Based on the investigation and prelimary conjecture, the goons of the Beret Society and their victims should be gathered deep within this place. Dougier must have expected trouble, and has prepared a suitable "welcome gift." As such, extensive preparations should be undertaken before entering.

name: Place of Secrets
description: Fatui intelligence indicates that this place may play host to heretofore unknown clues...

name: Place of Secrets
description: Fatui intelligence indicates that this place may play host to heretofore unknown clues...

name: Chiwang Terrace
description: In days now long forgotten, the ancestors of Chenyu Vale's people called this place the Hanging Gardens, with only their chosen shamans having the right to ascend to this place to listen to the teachings of the heavens and bring a blessing like that of the moon to the bountiful mountain plains. These ancient rituals have long since ceased, but the spirit veins of Chenyu Vale still gather in this place. Whosoever controls Chiwang Terrace may yet have the power to reshape the water and soil in this land in an instant...

name: Uther's Clothing Factory
description: A suspicious factory located in Fleuve Cendre. It may contain evidence of dishonest business practices on the part of its owner.

name: Rawat's Private Laboratory
description: With the aid of the clues you found in Rawat's residence, you found this hidden underground laboratory. The truth behind Rawat's disappearance and the case may be hidden within...

name: Place of Revelations
description: Dain brings you to where he hid the "eye" before. As you continue onward, the answers will soon be revealed. But when you step within, there seems to be something strange going on with Dain...

name: Remnants of the Secret Source
description: The sole path to the Night Kingdom. Once home to ancient dragonkind, now reduced to ruins. Influenced by the Abyss, the site harbors many unforeseen dangers...

name: "Realm of the Night Kingdom"
description: This is the realm of the dead, where the "River of Concepts" flows. Kachina, who is trapped here, is putting up a desperate struggle. Rescue her before it's too late!

name: The Secret Garden of "Auguste"
description: The ominous scent and the fragrance of "Auguste" have led you here. This journey is at its end, and vengeance is nigh.

name: Tlazolli's Forge
description: A workshop that Tlazolli announced had been abandoned and sealed off. Now, an ominous crackling echoes within...

name: Remnants of the Secret Source
description: A dragon ruin from antiquity. Within it are hidden large devices that can affect the Ley Lines. You must make every second count if The Captain and Ororon's radical plan is to be stopped.

name: Tepal's "Airborne Workshop"
description: Tepal's "Airborne Workshop," hidden above the clouds. Obsession piled up until it finally reached the vault of heaven.

name: Remnants of the Secret Source
description: A dragon ruin from antiquity. Within it are hidden large devices that can affect the Ley Lines. You must make every second count if The Captain and Ororon's radical plan is to be stopped.

name: Seven-Hued Ruins
description: Finally, following Etchemin's directions, Citlali managed to find the entrance to the ruined battlefield. All this time, it turns out that the secrets of the Battle of Seven Colors lay buried deep underground...

name: On the Path to War
description: Now that the Ancient Names have been forged, you are ready to step onto the final battlefield — for friends, for the beings that inhabit this land, for the flames, and for the legacy that shall be left behind... (This Domain may take some time to complete. For the best experience, it is recommended that you experience the next part of the story when you have ample time to complete it.)

name: Enter the "border"
description: Returning to this once familiar place, you find it afflicted by a calamity of unknown origin, such that even the director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor herself has been trapped within. If you choose to venture deeper, you must proceed with the utmost caution.

name: Bastion of Nightmares
description: Based on Miko's information, you and Mizuki manage to find Emura Chuuya's hiding place. Alone on a small island, this isolated house seems to harbor some kind of mystery. Even though there is a palpable sense of danger in the air, the two of you decide to venture inside...

name: Realm of Feasts Long Forgotten
description: According to the notes left by Modeste, this was where Remurian foreign legionaries once drank and made merry... But the spirits have vanished into whispers on the wind, and a veil of dust sleeps over every glass.

name: Temple of Cascading Colors: Ch'upikaq Tajin
description: The Source Servants once offered up flowers and candles to The Eighth. But now, all the flowers have withered, and the candlelight has died away. The empty winds still whisper unheard stories of the past.

name: Unknown Ruins
description: Some unknown ruins that Layla once stumbled into by mistake. It seems that many unanswered mysteries remain in the Great Red Sand.

name: A Laboratory Somewhere in the Universitas Magistrorum
description: The Universitas Magistrorum from Rerir's memories. What will become of Tholindis's fate beneath the Eclipse?

name: Phantom of the Sanctuary
description: Once a sacred place of the ancient Hyperboreans, its grand architecture stood as proof of their devotion to the moons. Yet now, even these crumbling ruins have turned to ash. The travelers should be well aware of the fate that befell them, and the new beginnings born in its wake.

description: Lost treasures reveal themselves only to those with true wisdom. Having solved the mystery of Arcadia, you finally arrive at the site of the treasure...

name: Trial: Scorching Fire and Raging Lightning
description: In these ruins you discover a now destroyed training ground belonging to an ancient civilization. To pass this trial, you need to take hold of vicious fire and crackling lightning to take down your enemy.

name: Explore: Windy Cliff
description: Though it lies deep underground, the strong winds filled every corridor of the ruin. Don't be discouraged! Find the treasure deep within the ruin!

name: Investigate: Secret Hideout
description: These ruins show signs of monster activity. This threat cannot go unaddressed if Mondstadt is to remain safe.

name: Explore: Travels of the Moonlit Venturer
description: Beneath the labyrinth lies the unexplored Moonlit Wonderland, a trove of pots and kettles. Search for what hidden treasures await discovery there.

name: Explore: Tarry Among the Peach Blossoms
description: This place was once a paradise from someone's dreams. Search through its former bountiful blossoms and restore peace to the land once more.

name: Explore: Voyage to the Sanguine Sky
description: This is the Realm of Clouds. Guizhong, its former ruler, acquired several ancient and evil artifacts during her research into mechanics. The adepti created this realm to contain them.

name: Explore: Lucky Encounter in the Clouds
description: Only by a stroke of luck may one chance upon this paradise enveloped by clouds and mist. Though it appears serene from the outside, there is peril to be found within.

name: Elemental Trial: Vaporize
description: Master the Vaporize reaction using Hydro and Pyro through this challenge.

name: Elemental Trial: Melt
description: Master the Melt reaction using Pyro and Cryo through this challenge.

name: Elemental Trial: Frozen
description: Master the Frozen reaction using Cryo and Hydro through this challenge.

name: Elemental Trial: Crystallize
description: Master the Crystallize reaction between Geo and Hydro, Pyro, Cryo and Electro through this challenge.

name: Elemental Trial: Swirl
description: Master the Swirl reaction between Anemo and Hydro, Pyro, Cryo and Electro through this challenge.

name: Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake I
description: Challenge a Revived Primo Geovishap that constantly changes Elemental Type. Even in its long dreams, it would constantly draw energy from the ley lines, perhaps waiting for the day to come when it could rise to meet the sun once more and unleash its long-festering fury, shattering rocks and tearing mountains asunder.

name: Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake II
description: Challenge a Revived Primo Geovishap that constantly changes Elemental Type. Even in its long dreams, it would constantly draw energy from the ley lines, perhaps waiting for the day to come when it could rise to meet the sun once more and unleash its long-festering fury, shattering rocks and tearing mountains asunder.

name: Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence I
description: Challenge the Dual Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale and Galloping Frost. A pair of mysterious puppets lost in the endless process of honing their combat skills finally meet a fearless wanderer in the depths of the world. Their mechanical bodies and hearts may keep them alive for a thousand years or more, but how many worthy foes can they meet in that time, and how many legendary battles will they fight?

name: Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence II
description: Challenge the Dual Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale and Galloping Frost. A pair of mysterious puppets lost in the endless process of honing their combat skills finally meet a fearless wanderer in the depths of the world. Their mechanical bodies and hearts may keep them alive for a thousand years or more, but how many worthy foes can they meet in that time, and how many legendary battles will they fight?

name: Lament: Bitter Hate I
description: Challenge the Hateful Oceanid, which now shows its true face to its foes. Having lost its territory and with no access to tranquil waters, the Oceanid writhes in endless grief, longing for all living things to hear the song of the waves and to at last taste the bitterness of tears.

name: Lament: Bitter Hate II
description: Challenge the Hateful Oceanid, which now shows its true face to its foes. Having lost its territory and with no access to tranquil waters, the Oceanid writhes in endless grief, longing for all living things to hear the song of the waves and to at last taste the bitterness of tears.

name: Wanderer's Threefold Challenge
description: Challenge the Hateful Oceanid, the Revived Primo Geovishap, and the Dual Maguu Kenki each in turn! There is such a thing as "the rule of three": Good omens must appear three times for good fortune to follow, a true victory requires winning three rounds in succession, and of course, it's good manners to bow thrice at the curtain call.

name: Tutelage: Castle of Scrolls
description: Deep within these rocky mountains is a sight that does not belong to this world. Many of those drawn to it do not belong to civilization.

name: Tutelage: King of Thieves
description: Once a samurai residence, now occupied by bandits. Purge the evildoers from within this place.

name: Tutelage: A Thousand Scrolls
description: This was once the final abode of a tengu warrior incarnate. Having since forsaken the world, it falls to you to solve the riddle they left behind and defeat the trespassing bandits.

name: Tutelage: Umigozen's Mansion
description: Once, in the ancient mansion of Umigozen, famed throughout Inazuma, there was a window that could be used to enjoy wine and observe the flowers outside. Now the mansion lies empty, and only bandits and thieves dwell within.

name: Tutelage: Nest-Bed of Ambition
description: This masterless mansion has become the haunt of monsters from the rift. Defeat them all and obtain the treasures within.

name: Beneath the Abandoned House
description: The trail of the elemental powder leads here, to a lone abandoned building that stands atop a cliff in Araumi. Through the crack in the door, you can vaguely see a trap door lying along the floorboards that leads underground. Perhaps this is a secret Fatui base.

name: The Jungle of Inverted Dreams
description: This was once upon a time a curious dream filled with adventure, a playground for children, but it has long been infested with Withering-corrupted Fungi and things worse still — yes, the beasts that bring calamity, too, have occupied this place...

name: The Nature of Sun and Rain
description: Both truth-seekers and crooks will still delve into the ancient ruins of Apam Woods to search for the flow of sun and rain. Regardless, they all become lost in the forest of dreams, its green maze as intricate as a spider's web.

name: The Universal Fungus
description: It is said that this was once a natural testing ground for experiments regarding the adaptability and evolutionary capabilities of spores. Whether this is true or not, it is inarguable that this place's Ley Lines make it a real hotbed of fungal evolution. Someone must cut this evolutionary pathway off before these Fungi can continue spreading and begin to endanger the forest and even the world beyond.

name: The Spirit Tree's Hall
description: This domain was occupied by desert bandits from who-knows-where. Perhaps they must have some unknown treasure on hand.

name: Sonata of the Snowy Path — Intense Scoring
description: The gates to an unknown Domain have once more swung open, and the Hypostases within have called to themselves a great many attendants to make up formidable fighting forces. Use the mysterious power of Dissonances within the Domain to defeat these mighty foes!

name: Suspiration of the Deceased
description: The halls of death do not welcome the deluge of living things. Walk through the winding corridors to clean up the overpopulating Fungi and slimes, along with those hilichurls who should not have occupied the place to start with. Perhaps such offerings will lead to unexpected rewards?

name: Mare Terrae
description: Legend has it that the legacy of the departed god contains the primal power of life and that its power can even surpass the laws of nature. When the pure Amrita seeps into the barren desert gravel, hope of new life persists in the fertile soil nourished by an underground sea. Now, it is a bastion of growth amid a desolate land ravaged by a tide of darkness.

name: Sanctuary of Solemnity
description: This was a temporary abode established outside the sea of flowers by the guardian priests of the true way in ancient times. Returning warriors and foreign pilgrims would fast and bathe here to cleanse themselves of impurity. This is said to have been because only the pure and innocent were eligible to enter the temple of the Lord of Amrita.

name: "La la la!"
description: Though you can't tell how this works, it seems that the Mystifying Megachurl has also learned how to use wind currents, making it a tough customer, and not to be underestimated!

name: "Domu a dada!"
description: According to your observations, this samachurl-occupied place bears many similarities to the Divine Ingenuity domain. Perhaps that samachurl had found its way in by mistake before discovering a way to use the Domain's power... Speaking of which, you can't help but feel sorry for this samachurl, in here all alone with nothing but countless cabbages to keep it company while the other hilichurls revel outside...

name: "Mi muhe ye!"
description: On your first visit to the Domain, the master lurking within turned out to be an unusually large samachurl, which Paimon has taken the liberty of naming the Mystifying Megachurl! Your intrusion seems to have upset it greatly, and battle is unavoidable. A Sextuple-Sized Sunsettia crisis is inbound!

name: "Muhe dada!"
description: The Mystifying Megachurl is somehow getting stronger as you fight, and has gained control over various Divine Ingenuity domain features! Best to win quick and snap it out of its delusions — it's not healthy for a hilichurl to huddle hidden while its homies have fun, awaiting affront and affray!
